dedupe_keys.name: agridata tn tunisia s agricultural open data portal about 1 140 data sets from 55 producers including market prices livestock markets food safety lists daily dam storage and rainfall

description: agridata.tn is the sector open data portal of Tunisia's Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, run with the agricultural observatory ONAGRI. It holds about 1,140 data sets from 55 producers, such as regional agricultural development offices, the dams directorate and the veterinary services, grouped in 21 themes, with 18 dashboards. For food supply it offers market prices, such as olive prices at the Gremda market in Sfax, weekly monitoring of livestock markets, food safety lists and livestock market monitoring; it also publishes the daily storage of Tunisia's dams and daily rainfall at 125 stations, which drive food production risk. Coverage is national, with data by governorate, market or station. The data are free and available to download as Excel or CSV through a CKAN catalogue and API, under Tunisia's national open public data licence. Caveats: data sets vary widely in coverage and update frequency, many are regional one-off tables, and descriptions are brief. Simulation uses: linking drought and dam storage to food production and prices, tracking market prices during supply shocks, and mapping food safety establishments. Related records: the FEWS NET data explorer (data-fews-net-data-explorer) covers food security in other countries, and the WFP global food prices (data-wfp-global-food-prices) include Tunisian markets.
